Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Panjab University Post Doctoral Fellowship Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Panjab University Post Doctoral Fellowship?
faq.answer: The recruitment is through a walk-in interview. Candidates should attend the interview on the specified date, which is 05 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Post Doctoral Fellowship?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 1,00,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for this fellowship?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for this fellowship is 40 years.

faq.question: Q4. Are there any relaxations in the age limit?
faq.answer: Yes, relaxation in age for SC/ST/OBC/Women candidates is applicable as per Government of India Norms or 5 years.

faq.question: Q5. What are the minimum qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Doctorate degree (Submitted/Awarded) in the relevant subject with published research work to their credit.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST).

faq.question: Q7. How will the candidates be selected?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies, and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview scheduled to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held at Panjab University, Chandigarh.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this Post Doctoral Fellowship?
faq.answer: The job type for this Post Doctoral Fellowship is Contractual.
